dish: A rotating themed tasting menu that changes every 10 weeks
w: Chef Anthony Scolaro and Brian Dolgowicz's downtown Wadsworth fine-dining room (Nov 2023) that reinvents its whole menu around a new theme every ten weeks. Reviewed twice by Akron Life ('elevates fine dining in Wadsworth'); its opening was covered by the Medina Gazette.

dish: Lobster bisque and chef Ben Myers' from-scratch dinner and Sunday brunch
w: Upscale-casual kitchen that opened in March 2025 inside Green's restored 1890 East Liberty one-room schoolhouse, after two years of renovation. Featured by Akron Life and reviewed by the Beacon Journal's Local Flavor ('old-school charm').

dish: Chef Beau Schmidt's chicken sausage with Creole mustard and his mother Jerry's scratch peanut-butter pie
w: Chef Beau Schmidt's long-running grill in the Hilton Akron/Fairlawn, with a covered 70-seat terrace. Profiled repeatedly by Akron Life ('Well Grilled Beau', 'Slice of Home', past Best of the City patio wins) and on the Beacon Journal's 2025 Greater Akron outdoor-dining list.

dish: Calabrese chicken over risotto with garlic-mushroom broccolini, paired with the house ice wines the name refers to
w: French-American restaurant and wine bar in Green's Heritage Crossing plaza, named for the sugar level of ice wine. In Akron Life's 'Gourmet Food in the City of Green' and on the Canton Repository's Stark-area patio round-up.
